title: Chapter 1: The Childhood Friends Who Became Idols and the Transfer Student Who Brings a Storm 4
content: "Yes! That's right! Good job, Arisa! Tell him more!"
Cat agreed with Arisa's point.
No, it wasn't just Cat; I could hear voices from all over the classroom saying, "That's right, that's right."
I didn't mind the idea of riding on the coattails of the stronger ones, but when it was turned against me, it was genuinely annoying...
"That's impressive, Arisa! You can say what we can't! I admire that! I was already a fan, but this resolute stance makes me want to support you even more!"
"Lady, you really have no sense of decorum."
Even the Transfer Student and her maid, who had been having a conversation just moments ago, were now nodding along and looking at me.
If Setsuna were here, things might have been different, but with her absence, there was no one on my side in this classroom.
I felt an indescribable sense of loneliness and a prickly feeling, causing me to sink into despair.
Arisa looked at me again with an exasperated expression, but...
"Honestly, you're really hopeless."
"Yeah, that's my Arisa! You're always reliable..."
"Really, Kazuha, you can't do without me."
"Right... wait, huh?"
"I realized that Kazuha needs me. Honestly, you never change."
"A-Arisa?"
As she muttered that, my strict Childhood Friend put her hand in her uniform pocket and said,
"Here, this is my allowance for you! You can't keep bothering Setsuna or waste money anymore!"
She looked away, her face flushed, and handed me a thick envelope.
"Yes! Finally!"
"Thank you! That's what a caring idol Childhood Friend is for! I really love you, Arisa!"
"W-Wait! What are you saying? Everyone's watching! I don't feel happy when you say that so casually!"
[img]https://i.imgur.com/e6YasLm.jpeg
"Don't worry about what's around you. Arisa got angry because she was thinking about me, right? I understand that perfectly. Thanks for always being there for me. I really appreciate it, Arisa."
"…Well, if you understand, that's good. I'm not a demon or anything, and if Kazuma can get his act together, then I..."
"It’s fine. I'm reflecting on it, and I'm grateful. I'll use this money wisely... at least as much as I can. Probably, definitely."
"Make sure you do. You always go crying to Setsuna instead of me... You should rely on me more, you idiot Kazuma."
"What? Were you worried about that? Sure, Setsuna is important, but... hey Arisa. You're also a really important childhood friend to me. I'm really glad you're here."
"~~~~~~! I-I’m not saying that’s the case! It’s just... hearing you say that makes me... um, happy, maybe..."
"I'll say it as many times as it takes. Arisa has been a truly important presence in my life for a long time. I want you to stay by my side forever. And, could you support me?"
"…Ugh, you idiot. I feel uneasy just relying on Setsuna alone, so it's only natural. It's only natural, okay?! I don’t want you to misunderstand!"
"…Is that not allowed?"
"Arisa..."
"Kazuma..."
"Wait, wait a minute!!??"
Just as Arisa and I were sharing a nice moment, Nekomiya barged in. Tch, what a nuisance.
"What’s up, Tamaki? We were in a good spot just now..."
"What are you doing, Arisa!? No, seriously, what are you doing!?"
Ah, man, I knew better than to try to raise my favorability in front of others. That aside, the class's attention shifted away from me and focused on the two girls.
Now's my chance. While they were distracted, I secretly checked the contents of the envelope.
"Eh, what do you mean...? I scolded Kazuma just like you asked. He seems to have reflected on it, and I just gave him some pocket money as a reward..."
"Scolding him was fine!? I appreciate that you did as I asked, but why would you give him pocket money afterward!!?? I don’t understand!!??"
Hee, hoo, mee... Oh, there’s quite a bit! As expected of Arisa. Unlike Setsuna, she tends to lecture when giving pocket money, but she gives more than Setsuna does, which is a nice point.
As I told Arisa, I need to use the reduced amount carefully. I need to set aside money for the gacha at the end of the month, after all.

"Because, from what I heard earlier, it seems Kazuma really doesn't have any money. It's sad that he can't eat anything, and if I leave him alone, he’ll just cry to Setsuna instead of me... I'm not jealous or anything, but I don’t want that to happen."
"Well, that's Kazuma's own fault, isn’t it!? It has nothing to do with you, Arisa!? There’s no reason for you to be jealous!"

"Of course it does. Because I care about Kazuma... no, he’s my childhood friend. I have to take care of him, and if I scold him properly and make him understand that he's done something wrong before giving him money, everything will be fine, right?"

"It won't be fine!? It’s not fine at all!? Kazuma was just happy to get the money! That doesn’t mean he reflected on anything! Also, what you said at the end was clearly off!!?? You’re completely misunderstanding kindness!!!??"
In times like this, I’m really glad to have a childhood friend who looks out for me. I really am a winner. A life full of excitement is definitely within my grasp!
Just as I was thinking that...
"Kazuma Kuzuha!!!"
When I looked up at my name being called, there stood Ijuuin with a face that looked like a young demon for some reason.
"What’s up, Ijuuin? You look scary."

"What do you mean, ‘what’s up’!!!? What kind of person are you!!!? Not only are you messing with Setsuna-sama, but you’re also seducing Arisa-sama!!?? You beast!!! You inhuman!!! A shameless scoundrel!!! The absolute worst kind of loser!!!"

Ijuuin cursed me with a roughness that was hard to believe for a lady. With her flashy blonde waves, she looked like she was radiating an aura. This must be what they mean by "anger rising to the heavens."
"Calm down, calm down, Ijuuin."
"How can I calm down!!?? I'm witnessing the collapse of ‘Damenz’ right before my eyes!!!"
On top of that, her face was as red as a boiled octopus, giving off an overwhelming sense of intimidation. It seemed she was completely furious.

"I had planned to use the Ijuuin family's influence to cover up most scandals, but to think there was a scoundrel who would dare to lay a hand on the double center of ‘Damenz’...! This is a grave error on my part...!"
"Even if you call me a scoundrel, that’s a problem for me. Arisa and I are just childhood friends."
"Do you think such an excuse will work!? Ugh, as someone with a fan club number in the single digits, I had a duty to protect the members of ‘Damenz’...!"
Ijuuin cut me off. She was clearly not listening, and it seemed she was so frustrated she was even grinding her teeth. Being a beauty only added to the intensity of the scene.
"No matter how much I regret it, I can’t take it back. What am I supposed to say to the other members...?"
"Well, you don’t really need to worry about that. The number is just based on who got there first."
She looked like she was genuinely lamenting, so I tried to be considerate, but for some reason, Ijuuin shot me an angry glare and said,
"Huh? What are you talking about?"
"I’m saying you don’t need to worry about the number..."

"Of course I do!!! The fan club number represents the depth of one’s feelings for ‘Dimension Stars!’ Among those who felt a connection to them, we competed to see how deep that love was! A single-digit number is a title given only to the chosen ones!!!"
Ijuuin passionately argued as if she were one of the knights of the round table. It seemed she took great pride in having a single-digit number, more than I had expected.

"Among them, there are those who have even more love for ‘Damenz’ than I do. Though I’ve never attended a fan club meeting, there’s a legendary No. 001 who constantly updates a blog overflowing with love for ‘Damenz’... a comrade and the only person I respect."
"Huh."
Ijuuin began to speak as if she were intoxicated by something. She seemed to have deep feelings for the fan club, but honestly, it was a bit troublesome to hear about it now.
"I’m frustrated, but that person is on another level. If No. 001 were to find out about this, how much sorrow and grief would they feel...?"
"I don’t think they’d be sad. They don’t really care."
Since it was becoming a hassle, I stated my honest opinion, but the next moment, the lady’s eyes widened in shock.
"Huh!? What do you know about it!?"
"Well, it’s not like I know anything..."
"You can’t possibly understand the feelings of someone who is trying to devour ‘Damenz’! There’s no way you could understand!!!"
Ijuuin’s face was bright red as she spoke rapidly. Her breathing was heavy, and it was clear that she was completely worked up.
"Fhoo! Fhoo!"
"Sorry to interrupt your anger, but I do understand."
"You’re still saying that...! If you don’t shut that mouth of yours, I’ll have my own thoughts..."
"Because I’m the fan club No. 001."
Suddenly, Ijuuin froze.
"…Huh?"
"Since it’s about me, there’s no way I wouldn’t understand the feelings of the person involved."
"Y-You’re lying! There’s no way I could believe such nonsense!"
"If that’s the case, look at this. My ‘Damenz’ membership card."
Proof over words. I held out my membership card right in front of Ijuuin, who was still frozen.
"See? My name and number are written right here. Clearly."
"Kazuma Kuzuha... ‘Dimension Stars!’ fan club... member No.... zero, zero, one...?"
As she read it out loud, Ijuuin's face changed dramatically. The red of anger drained away, leaving her pale as if she were having a nightmare. It was quite a sight.
It might not be good for her health, but she seemed sturdy enough to handle it.
"That’s right. I’m number one. So, do you understand now?"
"Zero, zero, one...? Wait, No. 001...? Huh? Huh?"
"Well, getting the top spot was partly luck. You know ‘Damenz’ wasn’t a popular group from the start, right?"

‘Dimension Stars!’ is now becoming a popular idol group, but it wasn’t all smooth sailing from the beginning. I recalled how the first live venue was a cramped box and how it started like an underground idol group.
Getting the top title by quickly completing the fan club membership process back then was indeed something to be happy about, and that title has certainly helped with my blog management.
However, the popularity they gained was due to the efforts of Arisa and the others. I believe it’s wrong to brag about it.
Ijuuin looked at me as if she couldn’t believe what she was seeing, but eventually, she seemed to accept reality. Trembling, she said,

"Kazuma Kuzuha is No. 001...? That person... no, before that. My love, my feelings for ‘Dimension Stars!’ lost to such a lowly man...? To someone who would lay a hand on idols, the absolute worst kind of scoundrel...?"
"No, I’m saying I didn’t lay a hand on Setsuna or the others..."

"Shut up! Scoundrels always say that to cover up their crimes!!! Even if you were the respected No. 001, I can’t just stand by and watch my ultimate idol be devoured by a loser! The name of the Ijuuin family will be tarnished!!!"

"Honestly, I think the Ijuuin family is already tarnished by the fact that you’re using it for idols. You’re the one who’s scandalous. Also, subtly shifting from being a fan club member to promoting the Ijuuin family is pretty sly."
"Shut up!!! That’s that, and this is this!!!"
Even though the maid gave a sharp retort, Ijuuin was blatantly defiant. She had been so flustered just a moment ago, but now she was completely composed.
Huh?
What was that? Just for a moment, I felt like the maid glanced at me. Was it just my imagination?

"Wake up, Arisa! Just because you’re childhood friends doesn’t mean you have to give him money!? That makes you a sugar mama! Don’t let your emotions get the best of you just because you’re childhood friends! If you do, you’ll just end up being used by Kazuma and devoured!"

"But if I’m not there, Kazuma will definitely become a loser, right? Setsuna is busy becoming an idol and earning money to support Kazuma, and she won’t listen to me. So, isn’t it only natural for me to give Kazuma some pocket money to lessen Setsuna’s burden?"
"It’s not natural! That’s a completely co-dependent way of thinking!? In the end, it’ll just lead to everyone, including you, becoming losers!?"
"That’s not true. As long as I’m responsible, it’s fine. At least as long as I’m watching, Kazuma won’t become a loser!"
"Why!? We’re having a conversation, but it’s like we’re not understanding each other at all!? …Kazuma, right? It’s all your fault...!"
While I was distracted by Ijuuin, it seemed like the others were getting all worked up.
(But isn’t Kazuma being a bit harsh...?)
Nekomiya, who had been talking with Arisa, looked pale as if she had seen a ghost, which was concerning, but I had no reason to be called that.
I mean, I’m just a perfectly normal high school boy... Well, I’ll set that aside for now.
The bell was about to ring, so this situation should settle down for now...
"Kazuma! What did you do to Arisa!?"
Crap. I let my guard down, and now it’s coming back to me.
(Guess I’ll have to retreat outside the classroom for now...)
As I was considering retreating, the door swung open as if reading my thoughts.

"Hey, everyone! Is there a new kid here? I was told this morning that a transfer student would be coming, and the teacher was in a frenzy preparing, but they haven’t shown up at the staff room at all. Why do I always have to deal with this...?"
Ugh! Yuki-chan came in through the front door! There’s no way I can make a break for it now.
Yuki-chan looked like she was about to cry, and after what happened yesterday, I couldn’t bring myself to slam her face into the door again, no matter how much I wanted to.
"Wait, Kazuma Kuzuha!! Where do you think you’re going!?"
Tch! Just when I was in a dilemma, Ijuuin came over too.
No choice. I’ll escape through the back door! I have to charge through!
With that decision, I dashed through the classroom, weaving between desks. Just as I reached the door...
Creak.
"Man, what a hassle. I ate too much at the ‘Damenz’ concert and passed out, and now my stomach is upset. I’ve been sleeping the whole time. It still hurts a bit, but good morning, everyone..."
"Sorry, Gotou-kun!"
At the worst possible moment, I forcibly pushed Gotou-kun, who had peeked into the classroom, aside and made my escape.
In that moment, I felt like I had pressed against something very soft, but I didn’t have time to think about that.
"W-Whoa!!! My stomach!!! Noooooo!!!!"
"G-Gotou!?"
"Are you okay? Hang in there!?"
"Don’t let it out! Hold it in!"
"Well, of course it’s going to come out!? Hold it in, hold it in!"
"Damn it, that loser! I won’t forgive you, Kazuma!"
"Wow, this is chaos... I’m totally shocked..."
"Oh, is the teacher here? I’m Ichinose Himeko, and I’m transferring here starting today. Nice to meet you!"
"Huh? Huh? Huh? Why is the maid here!? What’s going on with our class, with ‘Damenz’ and Ijuuin-san? I want to quit being a teacher!"
"‘Don’t run away!!!’"
"I’m freeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeee!"
Ignoring the various voices coming from behind me, I dashed through the morning hallway in search of freedom.
"Hey, don’t run in the hallway. You’ll be marked late, and we’re going back to the classroom."
I was easily caught by Arisa and ended up being dragged back to the classroom.
I couldn’t win against an idol...
